_about: HUD label table (`hud.*` keys, used by the HUD = `binary/wp8f.exe`). Core reads it **during startup** from the configured `hud_lang_path` (whichever file you point at — the only language key): only this read-only table is kept, the JSON text and intermediate objects are released immediately (`_lang`/`_name`/`_about` metadata never enters the table; the `[LANG]` startup log line reports "read N B -> resident M B"). **You may add any `resource/lang/xxx.json`**: keep the key set identical to zh.json/en.json and point `hud_lang_path` at it. The GUI's own 15 UI languages live in `resource/i18n/` and are independent.
